shortTitle: Going to UITH or the colleges? How to get there
title: Getting to UITH and the Old / New College
body: UITH and the Old and New College sites are not on the Main Campus, so you cannot walk there. Take a cab to the motor park first, then continue to your destination from there.
tips: It is a trip across town, not across campus — leave extra time, especially before a lecture or exam.
Agree the fare with the driver before you get in.
Tell the driver the exact name: "UITH", "Old College" or "New College".
note: Not yet confirmed on the ground: which motor park to use, the route and typical fares. To be checked on the field trip.
